versions.text: Verify that airframe and propulsion systems eliminate sources of self-induced foreign/domestic object damage (FOD/DOD) to engines. DoD/MIL Doc: JSSG-2001B: 3.3.1.1.1/4.3.1.1.1

Criterion: Verify that design practices and processes are in place to eliminate sources of self-induced foreign/domestic object damage (FOD/DOD) to the propulsion system. Standard: Design practices and processes adequately ensure that airframe equipment, fasteners, etc., in the intake path of the installed propulsion system are properly secured to prevent damaging ingestion or functional loss of the propulsion system. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, inspection and review of documentation. Inspection and analysis of documentation (e.g., FMEA, FMECA, SHA, SSHA) of systems within or upstream of the inlet verifies the absence of FOD/DOD generating failure modes. Inspection verifies that manufacturing and maintenance procedures contain FOD/DOD control practices.
